response.overview: Polat Alemdar, a skilled operative who infiltrates the Turkish underworld under a new identity, becomes deeply involved in the complex world of organized crime, political intrigue, and power struggles. As he rises through the ranks of the criminal underworld, Polat uncovers hidden connections between powerful figures and organizations while trying to complete his mission without exposing his true identity. The series explores loyalty, betrayal, power, justice, and the shadowy relationships between the state and the underworld.
